blind.description: A modular wall segment featuring an open rectangular casement window. The lower half features dark wood wainscoting panels, while the upper section has a plastered tan surface with a classical crown moulding along the top. The window has two wooden casement frames with multi-pane glass; one sash is swung wide open at a 90-degree angle and the other is opened partially. Surfaces are clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: A wide tan rectangular strip forming the top moulding of the wall, with two wooden window sashes protruding forward below it, one perpendicular and one angled.
blind.height_vs_figure: Slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 6 ft tall), and about two-thirds as wide as it is tall (roughly 4 ft wide).
